t: Legal Team Lead for Deal Desk - Transactions
content: ...t;br>We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic leader based in Amsterdam to join our global Legal Deal Desk team. The Deal Desk operates as a global function within the Commercial Legal team, and you will serve as one of four Team Leads reporting to the Head of Deal Desk. As a Team Lead on Deal Desk, you will manage and lead a lean team of commercial lawyers who negotiate contracts with our vendors and commercial partners. The role requires a leader with strong commercial contracting expertise who can act as a trusted advisor to senior internal stakeholders, while building and developing a high-performing team. You must have a strong drafting and negotiation background across a variety of complex, multi-jurisdictional commercial agreements and be able to leverage sophisticated legal expertise and communication skills into tangible, scalable value that accelerates Adyen's global growth.<br></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>What you will do:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><span style="font-weight: 400;">Manage, mentor, and develop a team of high-caliber, pragmatic commercial lawyers who draft, review, and negotiate complex, multi-jurisdictional commercial agreements with our vendors and commercial partners.&nbsp;<br></span></li> <li><span style="font-weight: 400;">Provide strategic, business-oriented legal advice to senior stakeholders across procurement, partnerships, product, and regulatory teams globally, including on our contracting principles, commercial projects, and legal and regulatory compliance within our vendor and partner contracts.&nbsp;<br></span></li> <li><span style="font-weight: 400;">Serve as the primary escalation point for your team, guiding strategic, risk-based decisions on complex legal issues and proposing &nbsp;improvements to mitigate future exposure.&nbsp;<br></span></li> <li><span style="font-weight: 400;">Drive legal automation efforts and process improvements to scale the team and b

Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.</span></p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>As Operational Incentive Manager, you own the accurate, timely calculation and operation of Adyen's compensation plans for the commercial teams. You are the person who knows how every plan works, runs it in the comps system and offline, resolves exceptions, and explains and defends the plan to the business. You also host enablement sessions so that sellers and managers understand how they are paid.</p> <p>This is a mid-level role: you work independently on day-to-day operations and own the process end to end, while larger plan design changes are decided with S&amp;E, Regional leaders, HR, CCO, Rewards and Finance.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Own Plan Calculation and Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Calculate and run payouts for the BDR, Sales, Sales Lead and AM plans each period, in the comps system and offline where needed (spreadsheets, reconciliations).</li> <li>Maintain plan setup in the comps system: claims, targets, rates, accelerators, thresholds, cap rules and eligibility.</li> <li>Reconcile source data with Finance and HR, and fix data issues before payout.</li> <li>Run the payout cycle on ti

This is a cross-functional role with no direct reporting line over the teams you work with.
